dialogue.text: What in the World am I?!?! This is a Second Time that they are trapping me inside the portals!!
Oh... What's Up... Mario?
NO, DON'T SAY "WHAT'S UP" TO ME, WHERE THE HELL AM I?!?!
My Doom!! Where I will murder Everybody on every Universe including You.
YOU MONSTER!!!!! NOW I HAD TO PUT THE END TO THIS, RIGHT NOW.
Oh... The Fat Short Italian Red Plumber, doesn't know about me...
Well... Mario... To tell you the truth... I'm a Glitch... So that means... it's impossible for you to kill me...
So... better figure it out, how to get rid of me... because I will do it FIRST.
You know? I've got an Idea! Let's play "Mario's Friday Night Funkin"!
It's where We sing, to see who won.
Oh... Uh... Ok?
So, Let's a make deal! If you won... Then That's indeed Game Over for me!
But If I Win...
then you have to SELF DESTRUCT YOURSELF.
Yeah, Yeah, One thing...
Have you been inside of the Portal before? If so... do you know that person you just met?
Yes I went to the Portal before... & no Idk whose that person is... but... DO YOU HAVE SOMETHING TO DO WITH THIS?
Well... That's MacOS Wario... That's one of my victims... I captured him since the New Years of 2025.
Wow, Thank you for your Information.
but that's evil... and you still didn't answer my question... DO. YOU. HAVE. SOMETHING. TO. DO. WITH. THIS.
With the portal? Hell Yeah!!! That's Me! I made that, so I can Torment you to death!!
i hope... you go to... HELL. That way you can learn to REPENT yourself to GOD.
Heh. Now C'mon Plumber boy... The crowd is waiting for us to start...
THERE IS NO CROWD. AND NOW WE WILL START THE CHALLENGE NOW.
